items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I spent a year-and-a-half playing with Mongo.

ctx.x: Let’s take you through the sequence of events that got you there. Was your first appearance on record that Montego Joe recording with Eddie Gomez and Milford...
That’s what I’m told. Either that, or the Mongo Santamaria that I did, called Go, Mongo.
But then you wind up in Blue Mitchell’s, a gig you would have been as well qualified for as anybody, having transcribed so many of his solos.
